g.text: Figure S5 | Distribution of PD-L1 TPS
Full-data model groups in both cohorts (JUPITER apparent; ESCORT frozen external). Nominal Pearson tests, no continuity or multiplicity correction.
Missing TPS remains in bar denominators and is excluded from tests.
